title: Spicy Argentinian Fish Stone Bowl
description: A flavorful and anti-inflammatory-friendly dish featuring seared fish, spicy nam pla sauce, and a crunchy stone bowl.

ingredients.name: nam pla sauce
ingredients.notes: spicy and made with fermented fish

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality extra-virgin olive oil

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use flaky sea salt for best flavor

ingredients.name: stone bowl or dolsot
ingredients.notes: available at Asian markets or online

instructions: Season the salmon fillets with cumin, coriander, and salt.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the salmon for 2-3 minutes per side, until cooked through.
While the salmon is cooking, heat the nam pla sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the freshly squeezed lime juice, olive oil, and red pepper flakes to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Transfer the cooked salmon to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Place the stone bowl or dolsot in the oven and heat for 5 minutes.
Remove the stone bowl from the oven and carefully place it on a heat-resistant surface.
Add the cooked salmon to the stone bowl, then spoon the spicy nam pla sauce over the top.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
Serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a simple green salad.
